title: Game On — First Words
subtitle: Learn the essential words on every game screen
description: Learn the essential words on every game screen — menus, HUDs, and more.
heroImagePrompt: Two friends sitting side by side in a dark gaming room, glowing screens illuminating their focused faces, controllers in hand, cinematic wide shot, dramatic blue and orange lighting
imageStyle: photorealistic cinematic still, movie trailer aesthetic, dramatic moody lighting, shallow depth of field, film grain texture, highly realistic people, high production value, widescreen composition, not stock photography

avatars.Alex: Close-up portrait headshot of a young male gamer named Alex, late teens, friendly confident smile, wearing a gaming headset around his neck, dark gaming room background with subtle RGB lighting
avatars.Sam: Close-up portrait headshot of a young female gamer named Sam, late teens, bright curious expression, casual style, dark gaming room background with subtle screen glow

vocabulary.definition: The person who is playing the game.
vocabulary.example: You are the player. Your character is on the screen.
vocabulary.imagePrompt: A young person leaning forward in a gaming chair, intensely focused on a glowing screen, controller in hand, dark room with dramatic screen glow illuminating their face

vocabulary.definition: The display you look at when you play.
vocabulary.example: Look at the screen — your health bar is nearly empty!
vocabulary.imagePrompt: Close-up of a large glowing gaming monitor showing a health bar nearly empty, dramatic red warning light, dark environment, cinematic glow

vocabulary.definition: The total number of points you have.
vocabulary.example: My score is 2,500 points. I am winning!
vocabulary.imagePrompt: A glowing digital scoreboard showing 2500 points on a game HUD, triumphant player in background raising fist, dramatic golden light

vocabulary.definition: A stage or section of the game.
vocabulary.example: This is level 6. It is very difficult!
vocabulary.imagePrompt: A cinematic level-up screen glowing on a monitor in a dark room, dramatic light rays, player silhouette in foreground looking at the screen

vocabulary.definition: How many times you can try again.
vocabulary.example: I have only two lives left. Be careful!
vocabulary.imagePrompt: Two glowing heart icons remaining on a game HUD, one already broken and dark, dramatic red and white lighting, sense of tension and urgency

vocabulary.definition: Health Points — how much health your character has.
vocabulary.example: My HP is 10 out of 100. I need a potion!
vocabulary.imagePrompt: An almost depleted red health bar on a dark game screen, just a sliver remaining, dramatic red emergency lighting, close-up cinematic shot
A close-up of a thumb pressing the glowing start button on a game controller, dramatic lighting, dark background, cinematic macro shot

vocabulary.definition: To stop the game for a moment without leaving.
vocabulary.example: Press P to pause the game. I need a break.
vocabulary.imagePrompt: A game screen frozen mid-action with PAUSED overlaid in glowing text, player leaning back in chair, dramatic stillness, cinematic shot

vocabulary.definition: To leave or exit the game completely.
vocabulary.example: I am tired. I will quit now and play tomorrow.
vocabulary.imagePrompt: A person slowly placing down their controller on a desk and standing up, tired expression, dark gaming room, cinematic over-the-shoulder shot

vocabulary.definition: The menu where you change options like sound.
vocabulary.example: Go to Settings to turn up the volume.
vocabulary.imagePrompt: A large game settings menu glowing on a monitor in a dark room, a hand reaching toward the screen, dramatic blue interface lighting

vocabulary.definition: The device you hold in your hands to play.
vocabulary.example: Use the controller to move your character.
vocabulary.imagePrompt: Cinematic close-up of two hands gripping a game controller, dramatic side lighting, dark background, film-quality shallow depth of field

vocabulary.definition: A list of options that appears on screen.
vocabulary.example: Choose your character in the menu before the game starts.
vocabulary.imagePrompt: A dramatic game main menu on a large screen, character selection options glowing, player silhouette standing in front of the screen, cinematic wide shot

phrasalVerbs.definition: Use this when you want to start the game.
phrasalVerbs.example: The game is ready — press Start to begin.
phrasalVerbs.imagePrompt: Cinematic shot of a finger about to press a glowing start button, dramatic anticipation, dark background with controller in focus

phrasalVerbs.example: My score is 1,800 points. How about you?
phrasalVerbs.imagePrompt: Two gamers looking at a score leaderboard on a screen, one pointing proudly, competitive atmosphere, dramatic screen glow

phrasalVerbs.definition: Say how many chances you still have.
phrasalVerbs.example: I have two lives left. I must be careful.
phrasalVerbs.imagePrompt: Tense gamer gripping controller tightly, only two life icons glowing on screen behind them, dramatic red lighting, cinematic tension

phrasalVerbs.definition: Use this when you need to change game options.
phrasalVerbs.example: The screen is too dark. Go to Settings to fix it.
phrasalVerbs.imagePrompt: Person navigating through a glowing settings menu on screen, dark room, blue interface light reflecting on their face, cinematic shot

phrasalVerbs.definition: Said when the game ends and you lose.
phrasalVerbs.example: You lost your last life. Game over!
phrasalVerbs.imagePrompt: Dramatic GAME OVER screen glowing red in a dark room, player slumped back in chair, defeated expression, cinematic wide shot

phrasalVerbs.definition: Say which stage of the game someone is on.
phrasalVerbs.example: Well done! You are on level 5 now.
phrasalVerbs.imagePrompt: Celebrating gamer punching the air as level 5 appears on screen in golden light, triumphant moment, cinematic dramatic lighting

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.text: Hey Sam! Are you ready? Press [[start:to begin the game]] — the game is waiting!

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.text: Wait! I need to go to [[settings:the menu where you change options]] first. The [[screen:the display you look at]] is too dark.

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.text: OK, no problem. What was your [[score:the total number of points you have]] yesterday? I got 2,500!

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.text: Only 1,800. But I was on [[level:a stage or section of the game]] 6! It is very hard.

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.text: How many [[life:how many times you can try again]] did you have at the end?

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.text: Only one life! And my [[hp:Health Points — how much health your character has]] was just 10 out of 100. It was terrible!

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.text: Ha! OK — I have my [[controller:the device you hold in your hands to play]] ready now. Let's go!

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.text: I can see the [[menu:a list of options that appears on screen]]. I am [[player:the person who is playing the game]] 1 and you are player 2. Ready?

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.text: Yes! But please don't [[quit:to leave or exit the game completely]] this time! And don't [[pause:to stop the game for a moment]] for ten minutes!

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.text: Ha ha, sorry about last time! Pressing Start now. Game on!
